Transparency removal also appears incomplete/inconsistent (an explicit bg with opacity modifier remains), and several unrelated styling/metadata changes were introduced.

missing_requirements.reason: No evidence in the provided modified files of any Tabs trigger/segment/button labeled “Add” being changed from disabled to enabled, nor any logic ensuring the Add form content is revealed when selected.

missing_requirements.requirement: Remove transparency from all popout dialog boxes and forms (fully opaque dialog surfaces/popovers; no Tailwind opacity modifiers like /10, /20, /50; no translucent/backdrop-blur styling), including nested popovers used inside dialogs.

Additionally, only UserManagementDialog and global CSS are shown; there is no direct diff evidence that *all* dialogs and nested popovers across the app were updated.
